_readme.title: NotYVOS Roadmap
_readme.howto: Snapshot synchronized from NotY215/NotYVOS/ROADMAP.md. The repository roadmap is canonical.

phases.name: Project Hygiene & Tooling
phases.description: Current sprint: Windows-first VirtualBox helper scripts, root CMake convenience targets, documentation and validation of the XMB workflow.

phases.name: VirtualBox First-Class Support
phases.description: Create a bootable VDI or raw-to-VDI workflow, configure VM defaults and attach the latest build artifacts.

phases.name: Packaging & Boot Experience
phases.description: Create a proper bootable disk/ISO, persistent media data partition and a smooth transition into the XMB.

phases.name: Media & Desktop Completeness
phases.description: Add photo/music/video playback, sound, theme refinements and networking UI.

phases.name: Input & Controllers
phases.description: Improve DualShock mapping, native USB/Bluetooth controller support and hotplug behavior.

phases.name: PS3 Runtime Foundation
phases.description: Investigate integrating PPU/SPU/DMA/RSX runtime components and a GameRunner for user-supplied content; not implemented in the current rewrite.

phases.name: Performance & Native Lean
phases.description: Explore JIT improvements, graphics translation, SPU scheduling and profiling after runtime foundations exist.

phases.name: Hardware & Distribution
phases.description: Validate real x86-64 hardware and prepare release ISO/VDI images and end-user documentation.

phases.name: Long-Term Extensions
phases.description: Consider online features, XMB plugins, multi-user profiles, cloud-save experiments and other architectures.
